prompt:
A horizontal strip of pixel art showing the vertical FRONT FACE of a raised wall/ledge, exactly as such faces look in a top-down JRPG map (we look straight at the face; it is the drop between an upper level and the floor). It fills the whole image edge to edge: the top 6% is the lit rim/lip of the upper surface, the face below gets gradually darker toward the bottom, and the bottom 8% is a dark contact band where it meets the floor. No floor, no sky, no objects in front. SEAMLESS horizontally (left edge continues into the right edge). The strip is about 256 x 128 art pixels (each art pixel about 7x7 image pixels). Material: a cliff of dark basalt columns with a crusty ash-covered top lip and faint red cracks
Premium modern hi-bit 2D pixel art ("HD pixel art" JRPG look), hand-placed pixels. Every art pixel is a crisp square of the same size across the whole image (about 8x8 image pixels per art pixel). No anti-aliasing, no blur, no soft brushes, no photographic texture, no noise, no dithering checkerboards. Clusters of 3-10 pixels with clear shapes. Hue-shifted colour ramps: shadows lean toward purple/red and are more saturated, highlights lean toward warm yellow. 4-6 shades per material, rich but earthy, worn and lived-in.
Lighting: neutral, soft, even light from the upper left, like a calm overcast evening; NO cast shadows, NO night darkness, NO light sources, NO glow, NO lamp light pools, NO vignette. (The game engine adds the night lighting on top later, so this must be the clean base colours.)
revised_prompt: Generate a seamless horizontally tileable pixel-art game asset: a wide horizontal strip, 2:1 aspect ratio, depicting ONLY the straight-on vertical FRONT FACE of a raised basalt cliff/ledge in a top-down JRPG map. The face fills the frame edge-to-edge; no upper surface visible except a thin ash-crusted lit rim occupying the top 6% of the image, no ground visible. Under the rim, dark basalt column faces run vertically downward, with irregular polygonal column divisions, angular broken stone clusters and restrained faint dark red fissures. The face darkens gradually toward the bottom by discrete pixel-art color bands; the bottom 8% is a dark contact band where the ledge meets the unseen floor. Left and right edges match continuously as a horizontal repeating tile; no edge framing. Premium modern HD 2D JRPG pixel art, about 256 x 128 ART pixels displayed enlarged with perfectly uniform sharp square pixel blocks, each art pixel ~7-8 screen pixels. Deliberately hand placed clear 3-10 pixel clusters; no antialiasing, no blur, no noise, no photo textures, no checkerboard dithering. Per material 4-6 earthy shades with hue-shift: warm muted yellow-gray upper ash highlights, charcoal gray basalt midtones, more saturated burgundy-purple deep shadows, subtle dim brick red cracks. Neutral soft even upper-left overcast lighting, clean base colors: no glow, no luminous lava, no cast shadows, no night filter, no vignette. Absolutely no objects, characters, sky, floor, or perspective side surfaces.
